scope: Current primary guidance, local public-source audit, passive production HTML and documented public query observations. No private account or paid keyword data.

accountData.searchConsole: unavailable; no connector or export inspected
accountData.GA4: unavailable; no connector or export inspected
accountData.Journey: unavailable; no connector or export inspected
accountData.reportedVisitorIncrease: not verified; not converted to sessions, search clicks or qualifying premium traffic

primaryGuidance.observation: Useful static content, crawlable contextual links and clear page-specific titles/descriptions matter. Word count and meta keywords are not useful targets.
primaryGuidance.releaseDecision: Preserve static article and restaurant HTML, stable URLs, topic links and distinctive metadata; do not manufacture keyword variants.

primaryGuidance.observation: Content should provide satisfying original work and trustworthy creation information; citations alone do not establish original value. Fabricated creator profiles are deceptive.
primaryGuidance.releaseDecision: Require distinct intent, source-backed original comparisons or worked examples, honest bylines and review scope for each new article.

primaryGuidance.observation: Generating many low-value pages primarily to manipulate ranking is scaled content abuse regardless of the production method.
primaryGuidance.releaseDecision: Separate searchable catalogue records from curated public articles; do not create indexed country-chain-nutrient permutations or count shell pages as articles.

primaryGuidance.observation: Use concise descriptive page titles, a clear main heading and restrained branding; avoid keyword repetition and boilerplate.
primaryGuidance.releaseDecision: Preserve existing unique title coverage, check all new titles against overlap and keep the market and real comparison explicit.

primaryGuidance.observation: Image elements with source URLs, responsive alternatives and relevant context support discovery. CSS-only images do not provide the same discoverability.
primaryGuidance.releaseDecision: Use ordinary img/picture elements for meaningful food visuals, honest alt text and licensed artwork; avoid exact-product claims for category illustrations.

primaryGuidance.observation: Alternate pages need reciprocal fully qualified hreflang links and self-reference; annotations describe genuine localized counterparts.
primaryGuidance.releaseDecision: Keep true market equivalents reciprocal and self-canonical; do not label an unrelated guide as an alternate or untranslated content as French.

primaryGuidance.observation: Rendering can be deferred, and not every crawler runs JavaScript. Substantial initial HTML, stable canonical tags and real anchor links remain useful.
primaryGuidance.releaseDecision: Retain prerendered guides and curated content while improving interactive finder and diary components.

primaryGuidance.observation: Unbounded filter combinations can waste crawling. Canonical hints alone do not guarantee crawl prevention; fragments generally do not create crawlable variants.
primaryGuidance.releaseDecision: Keep finite canonical listings, avoid sitemap entries for search/filter states and do not expose private food diary states as indexable pages.

monetizationSources.observation: Journey specifies at least 1,000 Tier 1-market sessions in 30 days plus content and traffic standards. This is not the core Mediavine revenue requirement.
Connected GA4, engagement, original brand-safe maintained content and qualifying premium sessions are evaluated together; image permissions are examined.
Traffic composition, poor site basics, template-heavy or excessive AI content and image concerns can affect a review. No local page count proves acceptance.
Grow is optional; the unified application connects Google Analytics.
Current program changes replace older advice requiring Grow installation before applying.
After approval the owner completes terms, site details, supplied script and ads.txt, identity verification and launch; none of those account actions happened in this audit.
Custom platforms can manually insert the site's actual supplied script in the shared head. No fabricated configuration is necessary.
An owner must connect the Google account and GA4 property matching the actual site. Timezone affects reporting comparisons.
Cloudflare Web Analytics uses a browser performance beacon; edge/security logs are separate evidence from that beacon or GA4 sessions.
Cloudflare states Web Analytics currently does not log query strings. This does not eliminate ordinary requested-URL hosting logs or justify putting private inputs in links.
A real GA4 account, property, web data stream and site tag are needed before claiming data collection.
Verify real collection requests and the account's diagnostics after authorized installation; a tag-shaped placeholder is not a measured setup.

limitations: Public query results are observations, not Google Search Console metrics, measured demand or ranking positions.
Proposed routes in the intent map are not counted as published here; the integrated editorial manifest controls final publication status.
Passive public HTML does not establish all browser requests, account configuration or CDN dashboard activity.
No application, sitemap submission, identity verification, advertising activation or account change was performed by this research task.
